decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts are a high-potential packaging option whose market value is still uncertain one year after launch, and keeping them on offer costs little because they draw on existing drilling, polishing and bonding capabilities, so the option stays open.

Carrier wafers for smaller diameter wafers extend the firm's core carrier business at very low holding cost and fit its strategy on reusable carriers and thin-wafer handling, and no negative evidence justifies abandoning them.
